test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

"The hall is being decorated by the staff."

options.text: The hall is decorated by the staff.
The staff has decorated the hall.
The staff are decorating the hall.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the passive voice sentence becomes the object in the active voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The hall is being decorated by the staff."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the staff" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "is being decorated" to "are decorating" (present continuous active).
 
• Ensure the object "the hall" follows the active verb for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The staff are decorating the hall."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The hall is decorated by the staff." – This is still in passive voice.
 
• **Option 2: **"The staff has decorated the hall." – Incorrect tense (present perfect active).
 
• **Option 3: **"The staff decorates the hall." – Incorrect tense (simple present active).
